base_width = 80.0

web_thickness = 5.0

hole_offset_x = 0.0

mount_hole_dia_total = mount_hole_dia + mount_hole_clearance
mount_offset_x = 30.0
mount_offset_y = 0.0

base = fillet(base.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), fillet_radius)

web1 = Pos(0, base_height/2 + web_spacing/2, 0) * Box(web_width, web_height, web_thickness)
web1 = fillet(web1.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), fillet_radius)
